messages:
Jo Chen (CEO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands compliance block — thanks everyone. We had a few customers ask about timelines: ISO cert target, SOC2 evidence handoff, and data-residency for Private deployments. Can owners call out who9s doing what and by when?

Ava (Security): I can take point on SOC2 evidence collection and the ISO gap scoping. Will need Legal for the control language and Platform for proof artifacts (logs, runbooks).

Priya (Legal): On the SOC2 handoff: we need a clear mapping of controls -> artifacts + named owner. Also we should prepare a short DPAs appendix for customers asking about EU residency.

Liam (Infra): For Private/data-residency: we should publish a short checklist for setup (regions supported, private-link, flow logs, export hooks). I9ll draft that, include terraform snippets and the minimal network diagram.

Sam (Sales): FYI a large prospect asked: can we guarantee log custody in EU for Private? They want KMS keys never leaving region. Need a blurb we can send asap.

Diego (Platform): We support region-scoped KMS in our Dedicated/Private builds. Two items: (1) audit-log export API to customer bucket (S3/GCS) will need a signed export job; (2) BYOK rotation needs a migration path documented. I9ll add sample export commands and an API spec.

Ava (Security): Proposed defaults: request-level audit logs retained 90 days; metadata/audit events 365 days. For Private customers we can offer contract extensions (e.g., 3+ years) by request but Legal + Privacy need to sign off.

Priya (Legal): Confirming: retention >3 years requires privacy approval. Also export to EU-only storage requires the customer to supply region-bounded storage and the appropriate DPA addition.

Liam (Infra): Draft VPC checklist ETA: 1993124120 (Friday EOD). Will include snippet: ```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_flow_log" "redwood_private" {
  log_group_name = "/redwood/private/flow"
  traffic_type   = "ALL"
}
```

Diego (Platform): Audit export prototype ETA: 1993124800 (next Mon). I9ll post sample CLI usage and the API path: POST /internal/v1/audit-exports with body {"bucket":"gs://..."}. Example CLI: ```bash
gsutil cp gs://redwood-audit-exports/1993123456/audit.ndjson gs://customer-bucket/```

Sam (Sales): Can we get a one-page FAQ for BYOK and rotation to share with prospects? 

Ava (Security): Yes. I9ll draft BYOK FAQ + short customer flow (how rotation works, what we require from customer KMS) by 1993125000 (next Tue).

Priya (Legal): I9ll review the FAQ and add required contractual text by 1993125400 (Wed).

Jo Chen (CEO): Good. Please add owners and these deadlines to the compliance workspace. Also include a short customer-facing note on expected delivery SLA for export jobs.

Diego (Platform): Filing technical ticket now: COM-611 (audit-export API + sample CLI). I9ll include a mock Postman collection in the ticket.

Ava (Security): Filing cross-team action item: COM-612 (SOC2 artifact tracker + initial uploads). I9ll populate the tracker with owners this week.

ops-bot: Recording and transcript uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/1993123456 (redwood.com SSO).

Liam (Infra): Heads-up: for on-prem HSM integrations we need customer VINs and an approved NDA flow. I9ll open a request with People Ops.

Sam (Sales): Thanks 1 Will circulate the FAQ draft to the AE team once it9s ready.

Jo Chen (CEO): Thanks everyone. Small sync next Wednesday 9am PT to check progress. If blockers appear, drop them in #leadership-ops.

Ava (Security): Will do. Posting tracker link here when ready. :thumbsup:
